payload.blocks: Phase 6 (the checkout copies) and through it phase 10. Phases 7 and 8 continue.
payload.headline: Phase 6: give the checkout crate the two entries its copies need, or keep those copies as named debt?

parts.cause: The survivor only creates fgw/<id> branches; unit-handoff.mjs and repo-locks.mjs create wf/<run>/<unit> at a caller path from a base. No survivor entry prunes a missing checkout's registration (git-ports.mjs prune). merge.mjs catch-up holds dispatch-cwd custody across create, Sync and remove, which RemoveRequest cannot take. Outside the footprint: test/runner/worktree-admin-multiprocess.test.mjs, command-manifest.json, scripts/run-tests.mjs, scripts/lib/test-file-watchdog.mjs. Report: reports/unit-261123-2305-p6-result.md.

options.cost: One planner wake, then two or three units (the crate entries, then the callers).
options.does: A planner splits phase 6: first the checkout crate and addon gain a create at a given branch, path and base, a prune of a missing checkout's registration, and a remove that takes a held custody handle (packages/execution/checkout/** and packages/git/node-addon/src/checkout.rs, already the row's allowed survivor); then the five callers move and the debt goes, with the four outside files added.
options.gain: The row closes in this plan with one checkout door and no Node copy (CA-D2).
options.harm: Changes Land's catch-up custody order, so it needs careful tests; more phases before phase 10.
options.label: A. Planner re-cuts phase 6 with survivor entries

options.cost: One small unit and one backlog row.
options.does: Phase 6 only rewords the worktree verb text (with the manifest added); phase 10 names the other debts with retiredBy a new backlog item for the checkout entries.
options.gain: No crate change now; phase 10 is not held up.
options.harm: Five Node checkout copies stay past this plan.
options.label: B. Keep the copies as named debt

parts.recommendation: A: the entries extend the existing door rather than add one, and they are what moving the copies needs.

scope.allows: For A: a planner re-cut of phase 6 and the footprint widening to the checkout crate, the addon's checkout.rs and the four named outside files.
scope.forbids: Renaming workflow branches, any change to Land beyond moving the catch-up onto the survivor, or another plan's files.

parts.what: The phase 6 unit (c-391018) changed nothing. Each of the five debt files needs something the checkout survivor (packages/execution/checkout, reached through the addon's checkout namespace) does not offer, or a caller outside the footprint.
